headline: Enhance CodeClip with AI-Powered Snippet Suggestions
summary: Integrate machine learning models to automatically suggest relevant code snippets based on user input, and incorporate real-time collaboration features using web sockets for better teamwork.
actions: Implement an AI model that analyzes user queries and suggests relevant code snippets from their collection or a curated database of popular snippets.
Add real-time collaboration capabilities by integrating WebSockets to allow multiple users to work on the same project simultaneously, sharing and discussing sn
Utilize public APIs like GitHub’s or GitLab’s for fetching trending or popular snippets related to user queries, enhancing the app's content richness.
